intentions.title: Give Studio one shared, family-organized component library instead of ad-hoc per-LiveView markup
intentions.evidence: studio_components.ex is an explicit facade (`defdelegate` re-exports) over Panes/Nav/Modals/Editor/EditorFields sub-modules under studio_components/, so `import BarkparkWeb.StudioComponents` brings every `<.component>` into scope while keeping compile-time attr/slot validation localized to the owning family module.

intentions.title: Make every document unfurl as a branded, correct social-share card with zero drift between write-time and read-time preview data
intentions.evidence: share_meta.ex head/1 emits og:*/twitter:*/JSON-LD from a manifest resolved in order content["preview"] -> Barkpark.Preview.project/3 (via apply/3 to avoid compile coupling) -> degraded_manifest; D3 absolutizes URLs against Endpoint.url() (no internal port, fixing #1190); D5 defaults to /images/og-default.jpg at 1200x630 so nothing unfurls blank; D12 never crashes on nil/partial manifests.

intentions.title: Keep the Studio classic editor's leaf-field rendering byte-identical to the pre-extraction StudioLive renderer while eliminating phantom-default persistence bugs
intentions.evidence: field_inputs.ex moduledoc states output is byte-identical to the legacy render_input/2 clauses except two deliberate fixes: color fields no longer persist a phantom #3b82f6 default, and optional selects no longer serialize a phantom first option — both via hidden-input mirrors so Content.Forms.build_content/2's empty-string drop keeps unset fields absent.

intentions.title: Delegate rich/structured field UX (image, reference, richText) to self-contained Web Components rather than server round-trips
intentions.evidence: field_inputs.ex image/reference/richText clauses render bp-media-picker/bp-reference-picker/bp-rich-text-editor with phx-update="ignore" + BarkparkFieldBridge hook, giving the WC sole DOM ownership and bridging value via a hidden input, per docs/studio/web-components.md.

intentions.title: Ship a zero-JS-dependency inline SVG icon system for consistent Studio chrome
intentions.evidence: icons.ex moduledoc "Inline SVG icons. No JS dependency." — a hand-maintained @icons map of Lucide-derived path data (file-text, settings, editor-header action icons, group-tab icons, theme-toggle icons) rendered inline rather than pulled from an external icon font/CDN.

intentions.title: Let editors see and trust exactly what changed between a draft and its published twin before publishing
intentions.evidence: draft_diff.ex computes a top-level, schema-driven field diff (:unchanged/:added/:removed/:changed) between draft and published content, rendering gracefully when published is nil, and explicitly scopes out nested composite diffing to keep v1 narrow per project CLAUDE.md guidance.

intentions.title: Provide a plugin-agnostic content preview pane so any registered plugin renderer can surface a side-pane preview without Studio knowing its type
intentions.evidence: onix_preview.ex content_preview/1 accepts pre-rendered iodata from Plugins.Registry.collect_content_renderer/3 (first-wins across plugins) and is doc-type-agnostic; the legacy onix_preview/1 shim is kept only to pin the original ONIX-specific visual contract for its test file.

intentions.title: Standardize destructive/consequential Studio actions behind one reusable dry-run-then-confirm modal
intentions.evidence: confirm_modal.ex implements a generic two-stage (initial -> dryrun) confirmation flow driven by schema-declared `kind: "modal"` actions, accepting event name strings so existing phx-click wiring like confirm_publish_dryrun keeps working unchanged.
